name: MVGS_CS_FINDING_CATEGORY
title: MV-GenomSeq finding category
description: Diagnostic significance of a rare-disease variant for the case (KDK RareDiseasesMolecular *.diagnosticSignificance). Interim component on MolGen diagnostische-implikation until the MolGen Befundkategorie CodeSystem (HDB-976) is published (DISCUSS-TD #27). 'finding-category' is the component code, the other concepts are its values.

concept.definition: Component code: category of the finding for the case (primary, incidental, candidate).
Variant explains (part of) the indication of the case (KDK diagnosticSignificance 'primary').
Variant unrelated to the indication of the case (KDK diagnosticSignificance 'incidental').
Variant considered a candidate for the indication, not yet confirmed (KDK diagnosticSignificance 'candidate').
